name: NOAA H11971 Bear Landing 2 m BAG with original USGS camera observations

producer.name: NOAA National Ocean Service and U.S. Geological Survey

units.historical_rockfish_visual_code: USGS camera code; not a catch count

rights.license: NOAA original survey CC0-1.0; USGS original camera data have no access constraint and require source credit and sharing of derived products

spatial.horizontal_crs: NAD83 UTM zone 10 (EPSG:26910 horizontal component); original camera positions use WGS84 with variable accuracy near 10 m

temporal.update_cadence: Static historical sources; recheck original hashes and current chart/closure feeds before review

provenance.access_service: Original NOAA NCEI BAG and original USGS DS 781 camera archive
transformations: Opened original regular BAG at 2 m and checked native depth, product uncertainty and 25 m measured-neighborhood support around original camera records.
Matched original USGS camera ZIP by SHA-256 f2cb502f075041760994197965716f33b448695bc1e9004368bd09b91f14fef8 and grouped 13 qualified records into two historical transects.
Reconciled the original NOAA descriptive-report hash with an 18-layer bounded ENC danger query and fresh complete CDFW MPA snapshot; emitted only a coordinate-free research receipt.

evidence.supports: Original survey report identifies MLLW sounding datum, 2 m depth surface, rocky bottom and office-added submerged rock; exact PDF SHA-256 46030ab9d07bdf79ca6521409e37e34fcbc9dfb2fdd973c72ac9140d5d4e52ad.
Original camera archive opened and pinned; 13 reviewed depth-qualified historical rock/cobble windows on two July 31, 2010 transects, nine with rockfish visual codes and none with lingcod codes.
All 18 bounded ENC danger layers were queried on September 25, 2026; 60 charted features in the review envelope, but no route or target clearance.
NOAA identifies its original survey data as CC0-1.0; the source-rights receipt pins the official page and USGS camera metadata hashes.
Original camera metadata states no access constraint, requires USGS credit, requests sharing derived products, and rules out navigational use.

limitations: The raster envelope includes masked cells; exact measurable footprint and survey holidays must be reviewed for each proposed area.
Original camera positions vary by about 10 m and 13 correlated observations on two transects are not 13 independent reefs or current catch evidence.
The original report's final office review added a submerged rock and retained older rocks with uncertain positions; exact HCell and current ENC feature geometry must be reconciled.
No charted seabed-area polygon was returned in the bounded current ENC query; a camera line cannot define a continuous rock boundary.

The source is held from fishing-target promotion and export until exact substrate, federal and state closure geometry, Mendocino species/method/date rules, route and harbor review pass. Source terms are reviewed, but any future derived camera product must credit USGS and address its sharing request.
